validation.schema: events table columns confirmed via information_schema; new schemas verified against reviewed source code, not live collected data
validation.compiler: All seven exact templates accepted by connected execute-sql using timestamp >= now() AND timestamp < now(); this validates compilation only, not data availability.

queries.name: Accepted action mix by day
caveats: Event observations, not completed agent runs, discovered jobs or unique users.
Includes older usage schema because these content-free event names retained their meaning.
queries.sql:
SELECT toDate(toTimeZone(timestamp, '{{timezone}}')) AS day,
    countIf(event = 'chat_sent') AS accepted_chat_sends,
    countIf(event = 'workflow_started') AS accepted_workflow_launches,
    countIf(event = 'job_sources_scanned') AS completed_ui_source_scans
FROM events
WHERE timestamp >= now() - INTERVAL {{days}} DAY AND timestamp < now()
    AND event IN ('chat_sent', 'workflow_started', 'job_sources_scanned')
GROUP BY day ORDER BY day LIMIT {{limit}}

queries.name: Observed workspace setup readiness by day
caveats: Observed boolean snapshots, not an installation activation rate or native funnel.
A workspace can contribute multiple observations; master consent and SDK initialization limit coverage.
queries.sql:
SELECT toDate(toTimeZone(timestamp, '{{timezone}}')) AS day,
    count() AS readiness_observations,
    countIf(properties.profile_ready = true) AS profile_ready_observations,
    countIf(properties.crew_ready = true) AS crew_ready_observations,
    countIf(properties.job_ready = true) AS job_ready_observations,
    countIf(properties.profile_ready = true AND properties.crew_ready = true AND properties.job_ready = true) AS all_ready_observations
FROM events
WHERE timestamp >= now() - INTERVAL {{days}} DAY AND timestamp < now() AND event = 'workspace_setup_observed' AND properties.renderer IN ('browser', 'electron') AND properties.analytics_schema = 2
    AND properties.profile_ready IN (true, false)
    AND properties.crew_ready IN (true, false)
    AND properties.job_ready IN (true, false)
GROUP BY day ORDER BY day LIMIT {{limit}}

queries.name: Observed deliberate request results and success latency
caveats: Only reviewed deliberate UI mutations; polling, streams, previews and browser input excluded.
Failure denominator excludes aborted requests; all other reviewed results included.
Latency percentiles include successful requests only. Empty groups/denominators mean unknown, never healthy zero.
queries.sql:
SELECT toDate(toTimeZone(timestamp, '{{timezone}}')) AS day,
    count() AS observed_requests,
    countIf(properties.result = 'success') AS successes,
    countIf(properties.result = 'aborted') AS aborted,
    countIf(properties.result IN ('http_error', 'network_error', 'invalid_response')) AS failures,
    100.0 * countIf(properties.result IN ('http_error', 'network_error', 'invalid_response')) / nullIf(countIf(properties.result != 'aborted'), 0) AS non_aborted_failure_percent,
    if(countIf(properties.result = 'success') > 0, quantileIf(0.5)(toFloat(properties.duration_ms), properties.result = 'success'), NULL) AS success_p50_ms,
    if(countIf(properties.result = 'success') > 0, quantileIf(0.95)(toFloat(properties.duration_ms), properties.result = 'success'), NULL) AS success_p95_ms
FROM events
WHERE timestamp >= now() - INTERVAL {{days}} DAY AND timestamp < now() AND event = 'api_request_finished' AND properties.renderer IN ('browser', 'electron') AND properties.analytics_schema = 2
    AND properties.result IN ('success', 'http_error', 'network_error', 'invalid_response', 'aborted')
    AND properties.duration_ms IS NOT NULL AND toFloat(properties.duration_ms) >= 0 AND toFloat(properties.duration_ms) <= 86400000
GROUP BY day ORDER BY day LIMIT {{limit}}

queries.name: Observed terminal run outcomes and measured duration
caveats: Runs must start while the opted-in observer is active; no historical backfill or closed-renderer coverage.
May include routines and follow-ups. Separate origins/devices can duplicate observations.
Missing/invalid duration is counted as an observed outcome but excluded from percentiles.
queries.sql:
SELECT toDate(toTimeZone(timestamp, '{{timezone}}')) AS day, properties.mode AS mode,
    count() AS observed_terminal_runs,
    countIf(properties.outcome = 'completed') AS completed,
    countIf(properties.outcome = 'failed') AS failed,
    countIf(properties.outcome = 'cancelled') AS cancelled,
    countIf(properties.duration_ms IS NOT NULL AND toFloat(properties.duration_ms) >= 0 AND toFloat(properties.duration_ms) <= 86400000) AS measured_runs,
    if(measured_runs > 0, quantileIf(0.5)(toFloat(properties.duration_ms), properties.duration_ms IS NOT NULL AND toFloat(properties.duration_ms) >= 0 AND toFloat(properties.duration_ms) <= 86400000), NULL) AS measured_p50_ms,
    if(measured_runs > 0, quantileIf(0.95)(toFloat(properties.duration_ms), properties.duration_ms IS NOT NULL AND toFloat(properties.duration_ms) >= 0 AND toFloat(properties.duration_ms) <= 86400000), NULL) AS measured_p95_ms
FROM events
WHERE timestamp >= now() - INTERVAL {{days}} DAY AND timestamp < now() AND event = 'run_finished' AND properties.renderer IN ('browser', 'electron') AND properties.analytics_schema = 2
    AND properties.mode IN ('workflow', 'chat') AND properties.outcome IN ('completed', 'failed', 'cancelled')
GROUP BY day, mode ORDER BY day, mode LIMIT {{limit}}

queries.name: Reviewed sanitized exception source totals
caveats: Deduplicated and rate-limited renderer observations; no daemon crash or provider-internal coverage.
Native automatic exceptions remain disabled; raw error text/stacks are never selected.
queries.sql:
SELECT toDate(toTimeZone(timestamp, '{{timezone}}')) AS day,
    countIf(properties.error_source IN ('window_error', 'unhandled_rejection')) AS global_exceptions,
    countIf(properties.error_source IN ('react_boundary', 'react_uncaught', 'react_recoverable')) AS react_exceptions,
    countIf(properties.error_source = 'api_action') AS deliberate_action_exceptions
FROM events
WHERE timestamp >= now() - INTERVAL {{days}} DAY AND timestamp < now() AND event = '$exception' AND properties.renderer IN ('browser', 'electron') AND properties.analytics_schema = 2
    AND properties.error_source IN ('window_error', 'unhandled_rejection', 'react_boundary', 'react_uncaught', 'react_recoverable', 'api_action')
    AND properties.error_category IN ('type_error', 'reference_error', 'range_error', 'syntax_error', 'uri_error', 'evaluation_error', 'generic_error', 'non_error', 'request_network', 'request_server', 'request_response')
GROUP BY day ORDER BY day LIMIT {{limit}}

queries.name: Imported completed CI attempt health
caveats: Custom opt-in repository import; native Engineering Analytics sources are separate.
UUID only deduplicates internally; never returned. All completed conclusions including cancellation/skips/retries in denominator.
Job span includes dependency gaps and excludes initial queue time; repeat attempts are not flaky-test classifications.
queries.sql:
SELECT toDate(toTimeZone(completed_at, '{{timezone}}')) AS day,
    count() AS completed_attempts,
    countIf(conclusion = 'success') AS successful_attempts,
    countIf(attempt > 1) AS repeat_attempts,
    100.0 * countIf(conclusion = 'success') / nullIf(count(), 0) AS success_percent,
    quantile(0.5)(job_span_seconds) AS p50_job_span_seconds,
    quantile(0.95)(job_span_seconds) AS p95_job_span_seconds
FROM (
    SELECT uuid AS uuid, min(timestamp) AS completed_at,
        any(properties.conclusion) AS conclusion,
        max(toInt(properties.attempt)) AS attempt,
        max(toFloat(properties.job_span_seconds)) AS job_span_seconds
    FROM events
    WHERE timestamp >= now() - INTERVAL {{days}} DAY AND timestamp < now() AND event = 'pitchcrew_ci_run_completed' AND properties.telemetry_source = 'github_repository' AND properties.engineering_schema = 1 AND properties.repository = 'pitchcrew'
        AND properties.conclusion IN ('success', 'failure', 'cancelled', 'skipped', 'timed_out', 'action_required', 'neutral', 'startup_failure', 'stale', 'other')
        AND properties.job_span_seconds IS NOT NULL AND toFloat(properties.job_span_seconds) >= 0
    GROUP BY uuid
)
GROUP BY day ORDER BY day LIMIT {{limit}}

queries.name: Imported merged PR throughput and open-to-merge timing
caveats: Bots and currently draft PRs excluded by importer; includes former draft and waiting time.
Open-to-merge is neither review time nor DORA cycle time. No developer rankings.
queries.sql:
SELECT toDate(toTimeZone(merged_at, '{{timezone}}')) AS day, target_branch AS target_branch,
    count() AS merged_prs,
    quantile(0.5)(open_to_merge_seconds) / 3600.0 AS p50_open_to_merge_hours,
    quantile(0.95)(open_to_merge_seconds) / 3600.0 AS p95_open_to_merge_hours
FROM (
    SELECT uuid AS uuid, min(timestamp) AS merged_at,
        any(properties.target_branch) AS target_branch,
        max(toFloat(properties.open_to_merge_seconds)) AS open_to_merge_seconds
    FROM events
    WHERE timestamp >= now() - INTERVAL {{days}} DAY AND timestamp < now() AND event = 'pitchcrew_pr_merged' AND properties.telemetry_source = 'github_repository' AND properties.engineering_schema = 1 AND properties.repository = 'pitchcrew'
        AND properties.target_branch IN ('dev', 'main')
        AND properties.open_to_merge_seconds IS NOT NULL AND toFloat(properties.open_to_merge_seconds) >= 0
    GROUP BY uuid
)
GROUP BY day, target_branch ORDER BY day, target_branch LIMIT {{limit}}
